mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADDRESSBOOK ( ADRS_NO, MEM_ID, ADRS_NAME, ADRS_TEL, ADRS_ADD, ADRS_MAIL )VALUES ( ADRS_SEQUENCE.NEXTVAL, #{memId}, #{adrsName}, #{adrsTel}, #{adrsAdd}, #{adrsMail} )
mapper.select: SELECT ADRS_NO, ADRS_NAME, ADRS_TEL, ADRS_ADD, ADRS_MAIL FROM ADDRESSBOOK WHERE ADRS_NAME = #{adrsName} AND MEM_ID = #{memId} ORDER BY ADRS_NO
SELECT ADRS_NO, ADRS_NAME, ADRS_TEL, ADRS_ADD, ADRS_MAIL FROM ADDRESSBOOK WHERE MEM_ID = #{memId} ORDER BY ADRS_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE ADDRESSBOOK SET ADRS_NAME = #{adrsName}, ADRS_TEL = #{adrsTel}, ADRS_ADD = #{adrsAdd}, ADRS_MAIL = #{adrsMail} WHERE ADRS_NO = #{adrsNo}
